name: Shinogi Chess Club 2: Resistance
source:
As Himiko Masaki continues the search for her mother, the resistance to change ever marches on when new rebellion groups challenge the city's obsession with Shinogi Chess, and the struggle for truth envelops Yoshino High School. Every move counts in Shinogi Chess Club 2: Resistance! 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2299430/Shinogi_Chess_Club_2_Resistance/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当正木卑美子继续寻找母亲时，新的叛乱组织挑战了这座城市对筱木棋的痴迷，对变革的抵抗不断发展，吉野高中笼罩着寻求真相的斗争。在《筱木国际象棋俱乐部2：抵抗》中，每一步棋都很重要！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2299430/Shinogi_Chess_Club_2_Resistance/]Steam[/url]]
